atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLookback = input(50, "Coil Lookback", 10, 150, 1)
vovLen = input(20, "VoV Length", 5, 60, 1)
predictLen = input(20, "Predictability Length", 5, 60, 1)
releaseMult = input(1.5, "Release Multiplier", 1.0, 3.0, 0.1)
coilThresh = input(0.75, "Coil Threshold", 0.5, 0.95, 0.05)
predThresh = input(0.55, "Predictability Threshold", 0.1, 0.9, 0.05)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

tr1 = high - low
tr2 = abs(high - close[1])
tr3 = abs(low - close[1])
tr = max(max(tr1, tr2), tr3)
atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
atrHigh = highest(atrVal, coilLookback)
coilRaw = 1 - atrVal / max(atrHigh, 0.000000001)
coilLoad = coilRaw > 1 ? 1 : (coilRaw < 0 ? 0 : coilRaw)
rangeNow = highest(high, coilLookback) - lowest(low, coilLookback)
rangeMax = highest(rangeNow, coilLookback)
atrChg = (atrVal - atrVal[1]) / max(atrVal[1], 0.000000001)
absAtrChg = abs(atrChg)
vovStd = stdev(atrChg, vovLen)
vovMean = sma(absAtrChg, vovLen)
vov = vovStd / max(vovMean, 0.000000001)
risingVoV = vov > vov[1]
priceChg1 = abs(close - close[1])
chgSum = sma(priceChg1, predictLen) * predictLen
disp = abs(close - close[predictLen])
predRaw = disp / max(chgSum, 0.000000001)
predictability = predRaw > 1 ? 1 : (predRaw < 0 ? 0 : predRaw)
isLoaded = coilLoad > coilThresh
isPredictable = predictability > predThresh
expansion = high - low > atrVal[1] * releaseMult and atrVal > atrVal[1]
buyCond = isLoaded and risingVoV and expansion and close > open
sellCond = isLoaded and risingVoV and expansion and close < open
buySig = buyCond and not buyCond[1]
sellSig = sellCond and not sellCond[1]

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy Release", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy Release", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell Release", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell Release", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 0, "separate")
}
if isLoaded {
  bgcolor("#123f3f")
}

plot(coilLoad, "Coil Load", "#14b8a6", 2, "line", "separate")
plot(predictability, "Predictability", "#ff9f1c", 2, "line", "separate")
plot3d(coilLoad, "Coil Load 3D", "ribbon", "#14b8a6", "separate", 0)
plot3d(predictability, "Predictability 3D", "line3d", "#ff9f1c", "separate", 1)
plot3d(vov, "Vol of Vol 3D", "scatter", "#b48cff", "separate", 2)

sessLen = input(20, "Session Length (bars)", 5, 200, 1)
htfLook = input(3, "1H Confirmation Lookback (bars)", 1, 20, 1)
qualThresh = input(60, "Structure Quality Threshold", 0, 100, 1)
stopOff = input(10.0, "Hard Stop Offset (points)", 0.5, 100.0, 0.5)
useModel = input(1, "Use model.* Calls For Backtester", 0, 1, 1)

sessHigh = highest(high, sessLen)
sessLow = lowest(low, sessLen)
sessHighPrev = sessHigh[1]
sessLowPrev = sessLow[1]

htfClose = security("1h", close)
htfHighSrc = security("1h", high)
htfLowSrc = security("1h", low)
htfHighWin = highest(htfHighSrc, htfLook)
htfLowWin = lowest(htfLowSrc, htfLook)
htfHighWinPrev = htfHighWin[1]
htfLowWinPrev = htfLowWin[1]
htfHighPrevBar = htfHighSrc[1]
htfLowPrevBar = htfLowSrc[1]

longBreak = htfClose > htfHighPrevBar
shortBreak = htfClose < htfLowPrevBar
htfTrend = longBreak ? 1 : shortBreak ? -1 : 0

trendOk = htfTrend != 0
alignLong = htfTrend == 1 and close > sessHighPrev
alignShort = htfTrend == -1 and close < sessLowPrev
alignOk = alignLong or alignShort
noWickLong = htfTrend == 1 and htfClose > htfHighWinPrev
noWickShort = htfTrend == -1 and htfClose < htfLowWinPrev
noWickOk = noWickLong or noWickShort

trendScore = trendOk ? 50 : 0
alignScore = alignOk ? 25 : 0
wickScore = noWickOk ? 25 : 0
confidence = trendScore + alignScore + wickScore
confNorm = confidence / 100

var longActive = 0.0
var longStopPx = 0.0
var shortActive = 0.0
var shortStopPx = 0.0

buyBreak = crossover(close, sessHighPrev)
sellBreak = crossunder(close, sessLowPrev)
buySig = buyBreak and htfTrend == 1 and confidence >= qualThresh
sellSig = sellBreak and htfTrend == -1 and confidence >= qualThresh

exitLongTech = crossunder(close, sessHighPrev)
exitShortTech = crossover(close, sessLowPrev)
hitLongStop = longActive == 1.0 and low <= longStopPx
hitShortStop = shortActive == 1.0 and high >= shortStopPx
exitLongSig = longActive == 1.0 and (exitLongTech or hitLongStop)
exitShortSig = shortActive == 1.0 and (exitShortTech or hitShortStop)

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    if useModel == 1 {
        model.confidence(confNorm)
        model.stopLoss(stopOff, "abs")
        model.longEntry("siegeL")
    }
    longActive := 1.0
    longStopPx := close - stopOff
    shortActive := 0.0
    shortStopPx := 0.0
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    if useModel == 1 {
        model.confidence(confNorm)
        model.stopLoss(stopOff, "abs")
        model.shortEntry("siegeS")
    }
    shortActive := 1.0
    shortStopPx := close + stopOff
    longActive := 0.0
    longStopPx := 0.0
}
if exitLongSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Exit Long", "x", "#ffcc33")
    if useModel == 1 {
        model.longExit("siegeL")
    }
    longActive := 0.0
    longStopPx := 0.0
}
if exitShortSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Exit Short", "x", "#ffcc33")
    if useModel == 1 {
        model.shortExit("siegeS")
    }
    shortActive := 0.0
    shortStopPx := 0.0
}

plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")

volLength = input(10, "Vol Length", 5, 30, 1)
momentumLength = input(12, "Momentum Length", 5, 30, 1)
breakoutLength = input(20, "Breakout Length", 10, 50, 1)
volMult = input(1.0, "Vol Mult", 0.5, 2.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

volRaw = high - low
volRange = high - low
volRefNow = highest(volRange, volLength)
volRefPrev = volRefNow[1]
expansion = volRaw > volMult * volRefPrev
mom = close - close[momentumLength]
hhNow = highest(high, breakoutLength)
brkHigh = hhNow[1]
llNow = lowest(low, breakoutLength)
brkLow = llNow[1]
breakoutUp = close > brkHigh
breakoutDn = close < brkLow
buyCond = breakoutUp and mom > 0 and expansion
sellCond = breakoutDn and mom < 0 and expansion
buyPrev = buyCond[1]
sellPrev = sellCond[1]
buySig = buyCond and not buyPrev
sellSig = sellCond and not sellPrev
expWarn = expansion and not breakoutUp and not breakoutDn

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if expansion {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "3d")
}
if expansion {
    bgcolor("#3a2e00")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "3d")
}
if expWarn {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Exp", "circle", "#ffaa00")
}

plot(brkHigh, "Breakout High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(brkLow, "Breakout Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(mom, "Momentum", "#ffaa00", 1, "separate")
hline(0, "#888888")
plot3d(brkHigh, "Breakout High 3D", "line3d", "#ff4477", "3d", 0)
plot3d(brkLow, "Breakout Low 3D", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 1)

lookback = input(80, "Lookback Length", 10, 300, 1)
f236 = input(0.236, "Fib 23.6%", 0.1, 0.9, 0.001)
f382 = input(0.382, "Fib 38.2%", 0.1, 0.9, 0.001)
f50 = input(0.5, "Fib 50%", 0.1, 0.9, 0.001)
f618 = input(0.618, "Fib 61.8%", 0.1, 0.9, 0.001)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

swingHigh = highest(high, lookback)
swingLow = lowest(low, lookback)
rng = swingHigh - swingLow

lvl236 = swingHigh - rng * f236
lvl382 = swingHigh - rng * f382
lvl50 = swingHigh - rng * f50
lvl618 = swingHigh - rng * f618

var lastSigBar = 0.0
var lastPrice = 0.0
var lastIsBuy = false
var hasEvent = false

buySig = crossover(close, lvl618)
sellSig = crossunder(close, lvl382)

buyFire = barstate.isconfirmed and buySig
sellFire = barstate.isconfirmed and sellSig

if buyFire {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 3, "3d")
    lastSigBar := bar_index
    lastPrice := lvl618
    lastIsBuy := true
    hasEvent := true
}
if sellFire {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Lost 38.2%", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Lost 38.2%", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "3d")
    lastSigBar := bar_index
    lastPrice := lvl382
    lastIsBuy := false
    hasEvent := true
}
if hasEvent {
    lblText = lastIsBuy and "Reclaim 61.8%" or "Lost 38.2%"
    lblColor = lastIsBuy and "#22cc88" or "#ff4477"
    text.new(lastSigBar, lastPrice, lblText, lblColor, 1, "fibEvent")
}

plot(lvl236, "23.6%", "#00ccff", 1, "stepline")
plot(lvl382, "38.2%", "#ffcc00", 1, "stepline")
plot(lvl50, "50%", "#b48cff", 1, "stepline")
plot(lvl618, "61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")

plot3d(lvl236, "Fib 23.6%", "line3d", "#00ccff", "3d", 0)
plot3d(lvl382, "Fib 38.2%", "line3d", "#ffcc00", "3d", 1)
plot3d(lvl50, "Fib 50%", "line3d", "#b48cff", "3d", 2)
plot3d(lvl618, "Fib 61.8%", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 3)

fastLen = input(10, "Fast Length", 5, 20, 1)
medLen = input(30, "Medium Length", 20, 50, 1)
slowLen = input(60, "Slow Length", 40, 100, 5)
skewLen = input(60, "Skew Range Length", 20, 120, 5)
compressionLookback = input(60, "Compression Lookback", 20, 120, 5)
expansionMult = input(1.15, "Expansion Mult", 1.02, 2.0, 0.01)
skewBull = input(0.2, "Skew Bull Level", -1.0, 1.0, 0.05)
skewBear = input(-0.2, "Skew Bear Level", -1.0, 1.0, 0.05)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

r = log(close / close[1])
fastVol = stdev(r, fastLen) * sqrt(fastLen)
medVol = stdev(r, medLen) * sqrt(medLen)
slowVol = stdev(r, slowLen) * sqrt(slowLen)
hi = highest(high, skewLen)
lo = lowest(low, skewLen)
rng = hi - lo + 0.0000000001
skew = (close - lo) / rng * 2 - 1
spreadFastSlow = fastVol - slowVol
spreadFastMed = fastVol - medVol
compLow = lowest(fastVol, compressionLookback)
compressed = fastVol <= compLow * 1.05
expanding = fastVol > fastVol[1] * expansionMult and fastVol > medVol
wasComp = compressed[1] or compressed[2] or compressed[3] or compressed[4] or compressed[5]
skewCrossUp = skew > skewBull and skew[1] <= skewBull
skewCrossDn = skew < skewBear and skew[1] >= skewBear

var episodeFired = 0.0

buyRaw = wasComp and expanding and skewCrossUp
sellRaw = wasComp and expanding and skewCrossDn
buySig = buyRaw and episodeFired == 0
sellSig = sellRaw and episodeFired == 0

if buySig or sellSig {
    episodeFired := 1
}
if not expanding {
    episodeFired := 0
}

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if buySig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 1, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "separate")
}

plot(spreadFastSlow, "Fast-Slow Spread", "#ffaa00", 2, "lower")
plot(spreadFastMed, "Fast-Med Spread", "#00ccff", 1, "lower")
plot(skew, "Skew", "#cc66ff", 1, "lower")
hline(0.2, "#22cc88", "lower")
hline(-0.2, "#ff4477", "lower")
hline(0, "#888888", "lower")
plot3d(medVol, "Term Structure", "manifold", "#7a4dff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(fastVol, "Front Spine", "ribbon", "#22cc88", "separate", 1)
plot3d(spreadFastSlow, "Spread Impulse", "bars3d", "#ffaa00", "separate", 2)

ch1 = input(50, "Ch1 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch2 = input(50, "Ch2 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch3 = input(50, "Ch3 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch4 = input(50, "Ch4 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch5 = input(50, "Ch5 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
maxScale = input(100, "Max Scale", 10, 200, 1)
thickMin = input(1, "Thickness Min", 1, 5, 1)
thickMax = input(5, "Thickness Max", 1, 10, 1)
buyLevel = input(70, "Buy Level", 0, 100, 1)
sellLevel = input(30, "Sell Level", 0, 100, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

rng = high - low
pos = (close - low) / (rng + 0.000000001)
wob = (pos - 0.5) * 10

r1 = ch1 + wob * 1.0
r2 = ch2 + wob * 0.9
r3 = ch3 + wob * 1.1
r4 = ch4 + wob * 0.7
r5 = ch5 + wob * 1.2

c1 = max(0, min(100, r1))
c2 = max(0, min(100, r2))
c3 = max(0, min(100, r3))
c4 = max(0, min(100, r4))
c5 = max(0, min(100, r5))

h1 = c1 / maxScale * 100
h2 = c2 / maxScale * 100
h3 = c3 / maxScale * 100
h4 = c4 / maxScale * 100
h5 = c5 / maxScale * 100

avg = (c1 + c2 + c3 + c4 + c5) / 5
t = thickMin + (avg / 100) * (thickMax - thickMin)

buySig = crossover(avg, buyLevel)
sellSig = crossunder(avg, sellLevel)
divCond = (c1 >= 100 or c2 >= 100 or c3 >= 100 or c4 >= 100 or c5 >= 100) and avg < buyLevel
divSig = divCond and not divCond[1]

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if divSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Div", "diamond", "#ffcc00")
}
if buySig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0 * markerSize, 5, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0 * markerSize, 5, "separate")
}
if divSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Div", "diamond", "#ffcc00", 1.0 * markerSize, 5, "separate")
}

plot(h1, "Cyl 1 Top h1", "#22cc88", 2, "separate")
plot(h2, "Cyl 2 Top h2", "#3388ff", 2, "separate")
plot(h3, "Cyl 3 Top h3", "#aa66ff", 2, "separate")
plot(h4, "Cyl 4 Top h4", "#ffaa00", 2, "separate")
plot(h5, "Cyl 5 Top h5", "#ff4477", 2, "separate")
plot(avg, "Spline Avg", "#ffffff", t, "separate")
hline(buyLevel, "#22cc88", "separate")
hline(sellLevel, "#ff4477", "separate")

plot3d(h1, "Cylinder 1", "bars3d", "#22cc88", "separate", 0)
plot3d(h2, "Cylinder 2", "bars3d", "#3388ff", "separate", 1)
plot3d(h3, "Cylinder 3", "bars3d", "#aa66ff", "separate", 2)
plot3d(h4, "Cylinder 4", "bars3d", "#ffaa00", "separate", 3)
plot3d(h5, "Cylinder 5", "bars3d", "#ff4477", "separate", 4)
plot3d(avg, "Top Spline", "ribbon", "#ffffff", "separate", 5)

flowBase = input(80, "Flow PSI Base", 0, 300, 1)
critThresh = input(150, "Critical Threshold", 50, 300, 1)
spinFactor = input(0.5, "Spin Factor", 0.05, 2.0, 0.05)
maxRings = input(5, "Max Rings", 1, 8, 1)
ringSpeed = input(2.0, "Ring Expansion Speed", 0.2, 5.0, 0.1)
ringMaxR = input(10.0, "Ring Max Radius", 4.0, 20.0, 0.5)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

flow_psi = flowBase + (close - open) * 5.0 + (high - low) * 2.0
spin_velocity = flow_psi * spinFactor
locked = flow_psi > critThresh
critLevel = critThresh + (high - low) * 0.5 + (close - open) * 0.2

var discRot = 0.0
var lockStartBar = 0.0

lockEvent = locked and not locked[1]
clearEvent = not locked and locked[1]

if locked {
  discRot := discRot[1]
} else {
  discRot := discRot[1] + spin_velocity
}

if lockEvent {
  lockStartBar := bar_index
}

lockAge = bar_index - lockStartBar
lockAgeGated = locked * lockAge
ringPhase = lockAgeGated * ringSpeed
ringSpan = ringMaxR / maxRings
ringR1 = ringPhase - floor(ringPhase / ringMaxR) * ringMaxR
ringPhase2 = ringPhase + ringSpan * 2.0
ringR2 = ringPhase2 - floor(ringPhase2 / ringMaxR) * ringMaxR
ringAvgR = (ringR1 + ringR2) / 2.0
discTurns = discRot / 360.0
discFrac = discTurns - floor(discTurns) * 1.0
discAngle = discFrac * 360.0
discVal = flow_psi + discAngle * 0.02
ringWave = flow_psi + ringAvgR
overpressure_flag = locked

if lockEvent {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "OVERPRESSURE", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if clearEvent {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Clear", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}

plot(flow_psi, "Flow PSI", "#22aaff", 2)
plot(discAngle, "Disc Angle", "#ffaa00", 1)
plot(critLevel, "Critical", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
hline(150, "#ff4477")

plot3d(discVal, "Valve Disc", "torus", "#22aaff", "separate")
plot3d(ringWave, "Shockwave Rings", "vortex", "#ff4477", "separate", 1)

if lockEvent {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, flow_psi, "Locked", "diamond", "#ff4477", markerSize, 0, "separate", 90.0, discAngle, 0.0)
}
if lockEvent {
  label3d(bar_index, flow_psi + 8.0, "OVERPRESSURE", "#ff4477", 2.0, 2, "separate")
}
